onScreenText: Where the money goes each month

pack.name: Owner pale glass (from the owner's five reference boards)

flow.rule: The boards never use red. Outflows are lavender or light blue and inflows teal. Colour is never the only signal: every gain or loss also carries a triangle glyph and a +/- sign.

gates.fillContrastNote: Fills are the owner's pastel colours used as large areas labelled in ink, so they only need to stay visible against the surface (1.5:1). Thin lines (line charts, outlines, arrows) use the derived stroke variant at 3:1; any text coloured like a series uses the derived text variant at 4.5:1.

geometry.evidence: Radius read from a 6x zoom of the Graph Atlas card corner (about 8-9 px on a 1536 px board). Border is a 1 px line (surface.border). Shadow is a faint 8 px halo below the edge (surface.shadowEdge).

type.identified: by eye from the boards (heavy geometric sans for titles, small tracked capitals for section labels); UNVERIFIED against the original design files
type.videoScaleNote: authored for phone legibility at 1920x1080, not measured from the boards (which are overview sheets)

motion.durationSource: Motion Grammar board, panels B and C (printed values)
motion.easingNote: board names mapped to no-overshoot curves (y within 0..1) from the motion research

components.source: Motion Grammar board panel A and Story System board

scene.evidence: AUTHORED from the owner's two sample motion videos (tilted floating layers, parallax, slow camera push) and the boards' soft glass cards; values are design choices within safe limits, not measurements.

trustRules.source: Graph Atlas, Story System and Motion Grammar boards

backgrounds.rule: background only blurred; low contrast behind data; avoid flat solid fills; 16:9 safe composition
